europe_now.title: French authorities investigate deadly shooting near Paris
europe_now.summary: French prosecutors are investigating a deadly drive-by shooting in a Paris suburb as a suspected terrorist attack. The incident resulted in one fatality and multiple injuries, prompting heightened security measures.

sources.headline: Deadly shooting near Paris investigated as 'crime of terrorism', minister says
French prosecutors investigate Paris shooting as suspected terror attack

europe_now.title: Mass security mobilization and student protests in France
europe_now.summary: France is deploying approximately 70,000 security personnel ahead of widespread weekend protests. President Macron has convened student representatives following recent unrest, looting, and clashes.

sources.headline: Major protests in France: Macron convenes student representatives

top_stories.title: Ukraine and Russia Prisoner Exchange
top_stories.summary: Ukraine and Russia have completed a prisoner of war exchange involving 270 individuals from each side. The release underscores ongoing high-stakes developments amid the broader regional conflict.

sources.headline: Ukraine and Russia each exchange 270 prisoners of war

top_stories.title: Black Sea Infrastructure Strike
top_stories.summary: A drone strike hit a ship operating in the Black Sea near Romania, resulting in at least one sailor's death. The maritime incident highlights persistent security risks to regional infrastructure and transport.

sources.headline: Drone hits another ship in Black Sea near Romania, killing at least 1 sailor
